# News Pulse

> Topic-clustered news timeline. Public RSS from BBC, NPR, The Guardian, and Al Jazeera is grouped with TF-IDF cosine similarity and plotted on a time axis.

## Pages
- [Timeline](/): cluster bars from earliest to latest article
- [Method](/about): sources, grouping rules, limitations
- [Privacy](/privacy)
- [Terms](/terms)

## API
- GET /clusters
- GET /clusters/:id
- GET /timeline
- POST /ingest/trigger
- GET /ingest/status/:jobId
